questions.scenario: Your family goes on a trip to Vaishno Devi or a long trek in Manali. What is your role?

options.text: Walking right at the front, shouting 'Jai Mata Di' or keeping everyone motivated when they get tired on the steep climb.
Making sure the train arrival timings, the hotel check-in, and the local taxi bookings line up perfectly without any delay.
Stopping at every scenic viewpoint to take aesthetic group photos and recording a mini-vlog for your Instagram.
Negotiating hard with the local pony-walas (horse rides) or taxi drivers to get the absolute best package deal for the family.

questions.scenario: Papa takes a wrong turn during a family road trip and gets completely lost. What do you do?

options.text: Roll down the window and confidently ask a local chai-wala or auto driver for the best shortcut.
Immediately open Google Maps, check the exact kilometer distance, traffic density, and ETA for the alternative route.
Enjoy the unexpected scenic detour, put on some good road trip music, and capture the funny family chaos on video.
Complain about the extra petrol cost being wasted and suggest you should have just hired a local cab instead.

questions.scenario: It's 10:00 AM and time to book IRCTC Tatkal tickets for the summer holidays. How are you helping?

options.text: You don't care about the booking process; you just want to pack your bags, reach the destination, and start exploring.
Sitting with the laptop open, passenger details auto-fill ready, typing the captcha at lightning speed to secure confirmed berths.
Dreaming about getting the side-lower window seat so you can make a beautiful time-lapse of the changing landscapes.
Calculating if a budget airline flight is actually cheaper than a 2nd AC train ticket after adding the on-board food expenses.

questions.scenario: Your school takes you on a picnic to a historical fort or water park. What are you doing?

options.text: Running ahead of the teachers, showing your friends the best spots, and reading the historical plaques aloud to the group.
Constantly checking your watch to make sure everyone gathers at the bus exactly at 4:30 PM so you don't leave late.
Forcing your friend group to coordinate their poses and finding the best lighting for the ultimate Instagram group picture.
Organizing the collected money from classmates and making sure the teacher gets the maximum group discount at the food court.

questions.scenario: You finally arrive at your hotel in Goa or Shimla. What is your first move?

options.text: Drop the bags and immediately want to step out to explore the local market or the nearest beach on foot.
Cross-check the booking ID at the reception and ensure you got the exact 'extra bed' or sea-view room you paid for.
Do a dramatic room tour video and take pictures of the view from the balcony before anyone ruins the neatly folded bedsheets.
Smoothly ask the receptionist if they offer a complimentary breakfast buffet or a free room upgrade.

questions.scenario: It's the night before a big family vacation. How are you packing your bags?

options.text: Packing comfortable trekking shoes, a cap, and a sturdy, lightweight backpack because you plan to walk everywhere.
Making a strict checklist of Aadhar cards, printouts of tickets, power banks, and essential emergency medicines.
Spending an hour deciding which outfits match the destination's vibe and carefully packing all your camera chargers and lenses.
Weighing the suitcases on a home weighing scale to make absolutely sure you don't cross the airline's 15kg limit and pay extra fees.

questions.scenario: Your friends are planning a local weekend trip, but the WhatsApp group is a mess. How do you fix it?

options.text: You take charge, pick a cool offbeat trekking spot you know, and hype everyone up to just show up.
You create a shared note with the exact hourly itinerary from morning pickup to evening drop-off so there is no confusion.
You send aesthetic reels of a beautiful nearby camping site to convince everyone to finally say 'yes' to the plan.
You calculate the exact per-head contribution (hissa) down to the last rupee using Splitwise and start collecting Google Pay transfers.

questions.scenario: You are traveling on a long-distance overnight train like the Rajdhani or Duronto. What keeps you busy?

options.text: Walking up and down the aisle, chatting with other families, and stepping out at every major station to stretch and observe the crowd.
Knowing exactly which station comes next, how long the halt is, and tracking the live running status on the NTES train app.
Waking up early to sit at the train door (safely) and catch the perfect sunrise video over the passing green fields.
Figuring out the pantry car schedule and subtly negotiating with the catering staff for an extra bowl of paneer in your dinner tray.

questions.scenario: You are visiting a famous but heavily crowded monument like the Taj Mahal or Red Fort.

options.text: Walking barefoot in the heat, observing the intricate marble carvings, and listening intently to the local guide's historical stories.
Figuring out the optimal route to bypass the massive crowd and finding the fastest security check line to save time.
Hunting for that one empty spot where you can take a stunning picture without 50 strangers photobombing the background.
Scolding the local photographers for charging Rs. 200 per photo and successfully bargaining them down to Rs. 50.

questions.scenario: The trip is finally over and you are in the taxi returning home. What's on your mind?

options.text: You are completely physically exhausted but already daydreaming about which mountain or beach you will conquer next.
You are mentally reviewing the trip to see if everything went exactly according to the planned schedule without any logistical hiccups.
You spend the entire return journey editing a travel reel with a trending Punjabi song so you can post it immediately.
You are calculating the final trip expenses to see if the entire vacation stayed within Papa's original budget.

Tour_Guide.title: The Explorer (Tour Guide / Trek Leader)
Tour_Guide.primary_match_text: You are a true adventurer! You hate sitting behind a desk. You are energetic, love being outdoors, and have a natural talent for leading groups and telling engaging stories.
Tour_Guide.day_in_the_life: Leading groups of tourists through historical monuments or mountain treks, sharing local legends, ensuring everyone's safety, and living out of a backpack.
Tour_Guide.alternative_match_text: Your love for the outdoors and physical stamina would also make you a great Archaeologist, Environmentalist, or Fitness Coach.
Tour_Guide.educational_roadmap: 11th/12th: Any Stream. Degree: B.A. in Tourism Studies, BBA in Travel and Tourism, or History. Next Steps: Complete certified courses from the Ministry of Tourism or mountaineering institutes like NIM.

Itinerary_Planner.title: The Logistics Master (Itinerary Planner / Ticketing Expert)
Itinerary_Planner.primary_match_text: You are the ultimate planner! You have an incredibly logical brain and a keen eye for detail. You love connecting the dots, solving puzzles, and making sure everything runs perfectly on time.
Itinerary_Planner.day_in_the_life: Sitting with multiple screens, booking complex international flight routes, designing minute-by-minute travel itineraries, and solving sudden visa or cancellation issues.
Itinerary_Planner.alternative_match_text: Your highly organized and detail-oriented brain makes you a perfect fit for Supply Chain Management, Event Operations, or Data Analytics.
Itinerary_Planner.educational_roadmap: 11th/12th: Commerce or Any Stream. Degree: BBA in Travel and Tourism Management or a Diploma in Travel & Ticketing (IATA certified). Next Steps: Gain experience with top online travel aggregators (MakeMyTrip, Yatra).

Travel_Photographer.title: The Memory Maker (Travel Photographer / Vlogger)
Travel_Photographer.primary_match_text: You are a creative soul with a beautiful perspective. You don't just see places; you feel them. You have an amazing sense of aesthetics, lighting, and how to tell a story visually.
Travel_Photographer.day_in_the_life: Traveling to exotic locations, waking up at 5 AM for the perfect sunrise shot, flying drones, editing cinematic videos, and building a massive social media audience.
Travel_Photographer.alternative_match_text: If not travel media, your creative and visual skills would make you a brilliant Filmmaker, Graphic Designer, or Content Marketing Specialist.
Travel_Photographer.educational_roadmap: 11th/12th: Arts or Any Stream. Degree: Bachelor of Mass Media (BMM) or B.A. in Journalism & Mass Communication. Next Steps: Build a strong digital portfolio and take specialized courses in cinematography and video editing.

Travel_Agency_Owner.title: The Trip Boss (Travel Agency Owner / Operations Head)
Travel_Agency_Owner.primary_match_text: You are a natural business leader with sharp negotiation skills. You love the idea of travel, but you are more focused on the big picture: managing the money, securing the best deals, and building an empire.
Travel_Agency_Owner.day_in_the_life: Partnering with massive hotel chains, designing profitable holiday packages, managing a team of travel agents, and ensuring your business hits its sales targets every holiday season.
Travel_Agency_Owner.alternative_match_text: Your leadership and business mindset would make you an excellent Entrepreneur, Sales Director, or Event Management CEO.
Travel_Agency_Owner.educational_roadmap: 11th/12th: Commerce is highly recommended. Degree: BBA or B.Com. Next Steps: Work in the corporate travel sector for a few years, then crack CAT/GMAT to pursue an MBA in Hospitality Management or Entrepreneurship.
